 Versus
 Ramniwas Singh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri R.P.Gupta - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Arvind Kumar Agrawal- Advocate for respondent No
 Order

This appeal filed by the claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of award dated 27/06/2012 passed by IV Additional M.A.C.T. District Morena (M.P.) in Claim Case No 154/2011 on account of inadequacy of the compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however, the finding recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

3. As per the finding of the Tribunal, in the case of injury received by the claimant in accident, the Tribunal awarded compensation of Rs.2,90,000/- with interest from filing of petition till its realization.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant contends that Tribunal has committed grave error in awarding amount towards his injury, 50% NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16620 2 MA-1002-2012 permanent disability and medical treatment and accepting earning of claimant as Rs. 3000/- per month is inadequate looking to the fact he was working as a labour.

However,
accepting the earning as Rs. 4400/- per month and adding future prospect, multiplier, treatment expenses, special diet and loss of income, attender and transportation expenses may be awarded.
It is further submitted that claimant received too much injuries and Tribunal has awarded less amount, therefore, he is seeking enhancement of compensation.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the findings recorded by the Tribunal.

6.After hearing the learned counsel appearing for the parties and on perusal of the record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the income of the claimant assessed by the Tribunal for calculating the compensation amount is on lower side which deserves to be enhanced as under :-
 Treatment 11,00  Special Diet 10,00  Income of loss 18,00  Permanent disability (4400X40% Future  prospect =1760=6160X1/2= 5,17,
 3080X12X14=
 Attender 20,00  Transportation 20,00
Physical and mental agony 50,00  Admit for 46 days 40,00
Total 6,86,
Tribunal
Awarded compensation 2,90,

Enhanced compensation 3,96,
7.

Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs 6,86,440/- as against the Award of the Claims Tribunal of Rs.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16620 3 MA-1002-2012 2,90,000/-.

Accordingly, the appellant/claimant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.3,96,440/- over and above the amount,
which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
8.
With the aforesaid modification, compensation amount is enhanced to a sum of Rs. 3,96,440/ -.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as fixed by the learned Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.
The said amount be paid within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

9. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.

10. This misc. appeal stands disposed of.
(HIRDESH) JUDGE Prachi Halke Ram vs Ramniwas Singh on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113720566/
